text: *Drafting:* I’ve started a small, reversible experiment using public library apps like Libby. Instead of committing to a long series, I borrow one random title from a genre I usually ignore. If the book doesn't grab me within the first twenty pages, I hit return and move on. It’s a surprisingly low-stakes way to discover new interests without the financial cost or the mental clutter of an unfinished book sitting on my nightstand.
